moral.zh: 情况会不断变化。解决问题前要重新观察，并根据眼前的情况调整办法，不能只守着过去的记号。
moral.en: Circumstances keep changing. Look again and adjust your method to the situation instead of clinging to an old marker.

idiomMeaning.zh: 比喻拘泥于旧办法，不懂得随着情况的变化而改变。
idiomMeaning.en: Literally “carving the boat to look for a sword”; it describes rigidly following an old method after the situation has changed.

pages.zh: 从前，楚国有个人乘木船过江。他腰间挂着一把装在剑鞘里的剑。
pages.en: Long ago, a traveler from Chu crossed a river in a wooden boat. A sword rested safely inside the scabbard at his waist.

pages.en: He did not ask the boatman to stop. Instead, he carved a small mark on the rail. “My sword fell from here.”
